# Long Pressed Name.

@example d stays single, r doubles, and the two o's of name share the five o's of typed (as blocks of 2 and 3, say).
"door"
"dooooorr"
=> true

@example name has two t's next to each other, but typed has only one.
"kettle"
"ketle"
=> false

@example The z at the end is not a copy of anything in name.
"mop"
"moppz"
=> false

# Single characters, equal and different.
"z"
"z"
=> true

"z"
"y"
=> false

# typed is shorter than name.
"abc"
"ab"
=> false

"aa"
"a"
=> false

# typed equals name, doubled letters included.
"ll"
"ll"
=> true

"bookkeeper"
"bookkeeper"
=> true

# A doubled letter of name shows up only once.
"pool"
"pol"
=> false

# The same letters in another order.
"abc"
"acb"
=> false

# The first characters differ.
"cat"
"bat"
=> false

# The first character is the one repeated.
"cat"
"cccat"
=> true

# A letter comes back after another one: its two blocks stay apart.
"aba"
"aabbbaa"
=> true

"aba"
"aaab"
=> false

# After the last block: more copies of the last letter, or another letter.
"ab"
"abbbb"
=> true

"xy"
"xyyz"
=> false

# An extra letter in the middle that copies neither neighbour.
"ace"
"acde"
=> false

# One letter changed.
"fish"
"fosh"
=> false

# Blocks longer than 255 and 127 characters: 200 a's stretched to 260, 260
# a's against 255, and 100 c's stretched to 130.
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab"
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaab"
=> true

"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
=> false

"cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"
"cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc"
=> true

# 500 a's and a b against 999 a's and a c: slow for a search that tries
# every block length.
""
""
=> false

# 300 blocks of one letter each (a, b, a, b, ...): block 100 is 2 long in
# name but 1 long in typed, while block 266 is stretched to 3.
""
""
=> false

# 999 blocks (xyzxyz...), typed adds one z at the end.
""
""
=> true

# Random cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"aacccbb"
"caacccbb"
=> false

@gen 2 small
"cc"
"ccc"
=> true

@gen 3 small
"bbbbbbaab"
"bbbbbbbbaaaab"
=> true

@gen 4 small
"baabbbccc"
"bbaabbbbccbc"
=> false

@gen 5 small
"bba"
"bbbbaa"
=> true

@gen 6 small
"aaccc"
"aaccccc"
=> true

@gen 7 small
"ccbbb"
"ccbbb"
=> true

# Full-size cases: runs of 250 to 300 letters; a long stretch (over 300
# runs) with its last character changed; and two true cases with typed 1000
# long, one with over 300 short runs and one with a few long runs.
@gen 6
""
""
=> false

@gen 3
""
""
=> false

@gen 4
""
""
=> true

@gen 8
""
""
=> true
